name: Content Guide
description: Shows configurable editorial guidance (rendered from Markdown files) next to form widgets for content editors.
project_description:
Content Guide directly integrates external help and documentation written in GitHub Flavored Markdown into your entity forms (i.e. when creating nodes).

This enhances the author experience and guides your authors through content creation.
 
 The documentation can be attached to any field in your form (see Known issues for limitations). You can choose between an integration as tooltip or to display the documentation as additional description.
